answer: Operator rule: every identity locks collateral equal to 150% of its lifetime earnings, rechecked each epoch. One fake earning 40 units locks 60 units; ten fakes earning 400 lock 600, and the delta is charged fleet-wide, so each new fake raises the bill on the operator's honest identities too. A shortfall freezes the whole fleet at once: one bad timber post cannot hold a roof, and the nectar of fake earnings turns into a frozen account.
